requirement.description: Production drift monitoring is broken. That is simply the state of the system today.
requirement.reading: That is simply the state of the system today.

narrator.name: Reliability Ruth
narrator.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The production drift monitoring pipeline has been throwing errors since the last deployment. The automated alerts that used to flag when forecast accuracy dipped below threshold no longer fire. The team now relies on a manual workaround, checking the validation metrics dashboard every morning before the forecast job starts to see if anything looks off. This process depends on someone remembering to look. It is the only way we currently catch issues before they hit the stores. The underlying service is still deployed, but the configuration is stale and the connection to the feature store times out, which is why the automated checks fail.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state, specific technical failures, and the manual workaround in use without expressing a wish, refusal, acceptance, or explicit trade-off.
output.humor_archetype: A health check that asks the wrong question
